samples.xml_description:
<module id="accu">
    <description>A module that accumulates four input data values and outputs their sum. It waits until valid_in is set to 1 before accepting new data, then outputs the accumulated result after receiving four valid input values.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock input for synchronization.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active-low reset signal.</input>
        <input id="data_in" width_description="[7:0]">8-bit input data for addition.</input>
        <input id="valid_in">Input signal indicating readiness for new data.</input>
        <output id="valid_out">Output signal indicating when 4 input data accumulation is reached.</output>
        <output id="data_out" width_description="[9:0]">10-bit output data representing the accumulated sum.</output>
    </ports>
    <implementation>
        // TODO: Please add your logic design here
        // For testbench verifying, do not modify input and output pin
        // Hint: You can use sequential always block to describe flip-flop's behavior
        reg [3:0] cnt;
        reg [9:0] sum;
        
        assign valid_out = ((cnt == 4'd4) ? 1 : 0);
        assign data_out = sum;
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                cnt <= 0;
                sum <= 0;
            end else begin
                if (valid_in && (cnt != 4'd4)) begin
                    cnt <= cnt + 1;
                    sum <= sum + data_in;
                end else if (cnt == 4'd4) begin
                    cnt <= 0;
                    sum <= 0;
                end else begin
                    cnt <= cnt;
                    sum <= sum;
                end
            end
        end
    </implementation>
</module>
